# Project rules index

Preserve the repository-specific requirements in AGENTS.md and read the
relevant local source before work. This index grants no external-action authority.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED BRAIN CONTRACT -->
<!-- Generated from https://github.com/altcoinist-com/ai-harness/blob/91c43530225418f7f37858ec23f981f4811d0dda/rules/shared/core.md; do not edit here. -->
- Resolve company facts and work ownership through company-context. Read its REPOS.md and ORG.md instead of copying their tables.
- Each fact, procedure and rule has one editable owner. Name conflicting sources and resolve them through that owner before relying on the disputed claim.
- Follow the destination's current lifecycle and protected boundaries. A router, skill, worker or generated rule pack grants no publication, messaging, scheduling or access authority.
- Keep durable corrections with their owning context, rule or skill within the task's authority. Recurring failures become owned improvement proposals and appropriate future checks.

| Trigger | Shared reference |
|---|---|
| Before creating or updating durable knowledge, or when sources conflict | Read `.claude/references/rules/shared/single-source-of-truth.md`. |
| When a durable correction or recurring failure changes future work | Read `.claude/references/rules/shared/knowledge-upkeep.md`. |
| Before crossing brain boundaries or delegating work | Read `.claude/references/rules/shared/execution-routing.md`. |
<!-- END GENERATED BRAIN CONTRACT -->
